title: Implement or refactor j9sock API for OSX
snippet: The existing Unix implementation of the `j9sock` API doesn't work on OSX. OSX supports functions as per the BSD implementation whereas the Unix implementation of `j9sock` API uses functions as per the GNU implementation. BSD and GNU definitions vary quite a bit. For some GNU functions, there is no BSD alternative. Plus, IPv4 and IPv6 categorization varies between the BSD and GNU implementation.
